_help: The ONE list of Visagie apps. Read by the website home page and by every app's 'More Visa apps' screen (no app update needed). New app: add a block, keep live:false until it is public on Google Play, then set live:true. Apps only show live apps to the public; test builds show all. icon = path on this site (256x256 PNG in img/). order = lower comes first.

apps.name: VisaSched
